ambiguity.detail: Clarissa's exact connection to Gerald and the family is unclear.
The Mysterious Bearded Man is not given a real name.

verdict.cliffhanger_line: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A rebellious bride rejects her toxic, disowning family at the altar to walk away with a rugged stranger.
verdict.why_it_works: High emotional stakes, immediate conflict, and a satisfying cinematic walk-out make this a great top-of-funnel vertical video.
